video_title: “He Should NEVER Pay For Anything Again” — French Montana On Brunson’s Greatness

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Jalen Brunson's playoff performance and legacy
quotes.excerpt: the outside world is still not respecting the greatness, the individual greatness that we just witnessed out of Jalen Brunson

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: To me, it feels like, not us, but the outside world is still not respecting the greatness, the individual greatness that we just witnessed out of Jalen Brunson on the big stage and throughout these playoffs. How do you two guys feel about Brunson and where he ranks all-time as a Knick? How do you feel about him period overall as a player and y'all valuing his greatness?

text_blocks.speaker: French Montana
text_blocks.text: I just think Brunson should never pay for nothing else in New York again for the rest of his life. So, is that mean he's a top-five Knick, top-two, top-three? He needs a statue.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: He needs a statue. Okay, so he's putting a statue up there.

text_blocks.speaker: French Montana
text_blocks.text: Yeah, he's definitely top-three greatest Knick ever.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Jalen Brunson's impact to Chris Paul's peak
quotes.excerpt: Brunson is kind of there with a little more killer instinct and dog in him

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: You got to look at Brunson is so underappreciated because of his size. You don't get them guards like that no more. They just don't make them. If you remember how Chris Paul was when he was at his apex, right? Brunson is kind of there with a little more killer instinct and dog in him. He's crafty. He know how to use the body. He's a stud. He can get you any basket anywhere in the game. He's just a dog, period.

text_blocks.speaker: French Montana
text_blocks.text: He's comfortable around his team. He set the tone. He won chips in college. He built the culture over here.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: What do y'all think about Jalen Brunson? What does he rank now that he's a champion all-time amongst bigs or Knicks? What do you have him as all-time Knick? Is he up in the top 10?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: He may not be an all-10 top Knick. That's fine. That's a big stat, okay. But that's a big stat. He in that top 15 ever. He right after the great. That's a big stat. But let me tell you something about this, now the people can finally take Jalen Brunson serious. He's not just a big man to shoot three-pointers. Y'all see all year the boy go off the ball, off the dribble, he's going to the cup and he's making it happen.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Crediting Tom Thibodeau for building the Knicks' culture
quotes.excerpt: I want to thank Tom Thibodeau for building the culture, right? Even though we got Mike Brown
quotes.quote: I want to thank Tom Thibodeau for building the culture, right? Even though we got Mike Brown, but I just want to thank Tom Thibodeau for setting the culture in place, getting us back in that, you know what I'm saying, with that grit and that grind. Mike Brown came and took over, brought us to the top.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his role as a bench player
quotes.excerpt: when you came off that bench, you was going to get quality minutes
quotes.quote: When you came off that bench, you was going to get quality minutes. I don't give a fuck if it was 8, 12 minutes. You was going to get 12 quality minutes. You might get 6, 7 quality points. You going to get your free throws. You going to get 5 hard fouls. You going to go out and be the dog. That's what you get. Every night, they going to go play and he going to get do what it do.
